Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. Looking at my calendar, these are the slots I have free:

- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30

Do any of those work for you? If none does, tell me when you're free and I'll see what I can move.

— Prof. Alvarez

Hi Prof. Alvarez — Wednesday 10:00-10:30 works for me, and it doesn't clash with anything on my calendar. I've put it in as the CSE455 staff meeting.

Of the other slots: Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00 and Tue 11:00 fall inside my reading group, lunch and advisor 1:1; Tue 15:00 runs into my CSE455 office hours; Wed 13:00 runs into my quiz section.

— Sarah

Confirmed — Wed 10:00-10:30 is in my calendar too, and it's logged. It's a staff meeting, so I'll leave it to the two of us unless the office has something to add.

— Prof. Alvarez

Thanks — Wed 10:00-10:30 is on both calendars then, so it's booked. If the office sends anything that touches it, I'll let you know.

— Sarah
